newsitem.title: USA: Bucyrus to be acquired for $18/share.
newsitem.headline: Bucyrus to be acquired for $18/share.

text.p: Bucyrus International Inc said Thursday it entered into a letter of intent to be acquired for $18 a share by American Industrial Partners Capital Fund II LP, or one of its affiliates.
Under the terms of the letter, the private investment partnership would acquire all shares of Bucyrus.
The deal is subject to the execution of a definitive agreement, financing, and shareholder, board of directors and regulatory approvals.

Bucyrus said it does not expect the transaction to have any effect on its previously announced acquisition of Marion Power Shovel Co. In April, Bucyrus said it signed a letter of intent to buy Marion from Global Industrial Technologies Inc for an undisclosed amount.
Bucyrus manufactures large-scale surface mining equipment and provides aftermarket parts and services.
American Industrial Partners is a private investment partnership which makes equity investments in public and privately held companies.
